name: Shad Suk Mynsiem
description: Khasi spring thanksgiving dance festival — celebrating harmony with nature after sowing
basis: Set each year by Seng Khasi; Meghalaya local holiday notice for Apr 13, 2026

name: Nongkrem Dance
description: Khasi 5-day harvest festival — chief (Syiem) prays to Ka Blei Synshar for prosperity and good harvest
basis: Set by the Syiem of Hima Khyrim; 2026 main days Nov 1 to 2 at Smit

name: Wangala Festival
description: Garo 100 Drums Festival — thanksgiving to Sun God Saljong for harvest
basis: Set by organisers each year; sources disagree for 2026 (Nov 6, or the Hundred Drums Nov 11 to 14), not verified
